about: A central sealer's tree (format description, section 21.7): the leaf fingerprint of each line, and the number of entries and top fingerprint after each leaf fingerprint taken in.

cases.name: a line with letters outside ASCII

refused.message: line: must not be empty: no line of a book is.

cases.name: a line with its line feed

refused.message: line: must be one line of a book, without its line feed.

cases.name: a line feed inside a line

refused.message: line: must be one line of a book, without its line feed.

cases.name: a line with a lone surrogate

refused.message: line: must be well-formed Unicode text: a line of a book is written in UTF-8.

cases.name: a line that is not text

refused.message: line: must be text: one line of a book, without its line feed.

cases.name: a line of 43,691 three-byte letters: 131,073 bytes

refused.message: line: must be at most 131,072 bytes, as a line of a book is.
